data.name: Amlesh
data.gender_notes: Amlesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amlesh derives from the Sanskrit words ‘amr’ meaning immortal or imperishable, and ‘leh’ meaning body or form. This name is associated with the gods Vishnu and Rama, symbolizing their eternal nature. The name Amlesh carries the meaning “Immortal, Imperishable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amlesh usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, imperishable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine and eternal aspect of the self.
data.etymology: Amlesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Imperishable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amlesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
